body:
## Summary

- Bump the canonical Sepo runtime version to `0.2.0` in `.agent/package.json` and `.agent/package-lock.json`.
- Add `.agent/CHANGELOG.md` notes for the 0.2.0 release.
- Validate `0.2.0` as a SemVer pre-1.0 minor release for meaningful agent and workflow changes under `.agent/docs/technical-details/versioning.md`.

## Checks

- `node -e` package and lockfile version consistency check
- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/release-version.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/prepare-release-cli.test.js`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #290
title: Prepare Sepo 0.2.0 release
